department: School of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences

deadline.value: School of Graduate Studies sets April 1 as the Fall application deadline for international F-1 degree-seeking applicants (unless an earlier program deadline applies); Morgan's Application Deadlines portal lists June 1, 2027 for Integrated Materials Science, PhD (Fall 2027), and SGS funding applications are due April 30.
deadline.quote: Application deadlines for the School of Graduate Studies (SGS) are as follows (unless earlier deadline dates are indicated by the individual programs): ... International, degree-seeking (All F-1 in and out of USA) Fall - April 1

also.quote: Integrated Materials Science, PhD Tuesday, June 1, 2027 Fall 2027 Graduate Integrated Materials Science, PhD

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Materials Science; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students form a doctoral advisory committee by the end of the first year after admission; no pre-admission advisor requirement is stated.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships (TA/RA, $21,000 doctoral stipend plus tuition award up to 9 credits/semester excluding university fees) and fellowships require a separate School of Graduate Studies funding application (due April 30 for Fall) and are not guaranteed.
funding.quote: SUBMISSION OF A FUNDING APPLICATION DOES NOT MEAN YOU WILL BE APPROVED. The decisions will be based on program selection and availability of funding per each program. | Graduate assistantships for doctoral and master's degree students pay a stipend ($21,000-doctoral $12,000-master's) Tuition awards do not pay for university and miscellaneous fees.

entry_route.value: Requires 60 graduate credits beyond a bachelor's degree (with a pass-through en passant M.S. after 30 credits) or 36 graduate credits beyond a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: The required minimum coursework for the Ph.D. in Integrated Materials Science is 60 graduate credits beyond the bachelor’s degree. 36 graduate credits beyond the master’s degree are required.

notes: Interdisciplinary SCMNS/SOE program spanning physics, chemistry, materials science, and electrical engineering. Spring admission deadline is December 1.
name: Integrated Materials Science
